name: UltraData-IF-1.5B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. An RL-trained instruction-following model initialized from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and trained on the instruction-following subset of openbmb/UltraData-SFT-2605; identical tensor set (28 layers, 1536 hidden). Recorded because the card prints the student and teacher columns in one table and the teacher wins all eight rows - Multi-IF 3-turn mean 40.39 vs 28.56, IFBench prompt-level strict 17.00 vs 10.33. Caveat that matters for reading it: the card's frame is on-policy distillation, so this model's role is the teacher, and the table is the paper's setup rather than a head-to-head capability survey - but both models are the same size and architecture, so the numbers are comparable. Licence 'other' (undisclosed), repo created 2026-09-03.
